item.title: Critical flaw in Acme Gateway exploited in the wild
item.description: CVE-2026-0001 has a CVSS score of 9.8 and affects Acme Gateway 4.x. It is being exploited.

item.title: Two bugs patched in Widget Server
item.description: CVE-2026-0002 is rated CVSS 5.3 and leaks data. Separately, cve-2026-0003 is a denial of service with no score published.
